The '''''Gasbag''''' was a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] tanker manufactured by the [[BramDorc Corporation]]. By [[44 ABY]] it was one of the last BramDorc products known to still exist, and had been turned into the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] fortress of a two-bit [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].
